main_measure.name: mean excess forward 10-bar return on positioned blocks vs window mean
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and hit-rate difference > 0) confirms; mean < 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: hit rate of positioned blocks minus hit rate of all blocks (slope of forward return on forecast reported in slope_value)

decided_by: Rejected: mean excess forward 10-bar return is below 0 with t <= -2.
reading: Blocks are the bars at positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window, and the coin's window mean ("all bars") is taken over that same grid. Positioned means forecast > 0 on the block's first bar. The t is the ordinary t of the pooled mean excess. The per-coin minimum applies to every coin present. The forecast-size slope is reported but not required, because the confirm rule names only the hit-rate difference.
